title: NMR console, Section A: the analog front end, the instrument and its housing
blurb: The analog side of the class board: 13 nets from the link header to the SMA field and TX coil terminal, routed with no vias - and the instrument it becomes: an 8-channel, 16-bit voltmeter and two-channel scope with a spectrum on a phone, alarms, a Telegram bot. Housing from my own spec: no vents, names in white, a two-part cover that prints without supports. Real-board numbers in mid-October.
